notes.text: containd v0.1.16 switched the container base image from distroless to debian:bookworm-slim to support a real Linux shell with tcpdump for lab and training use. At initial publication, this change inherited 39 reported HIGH/CRITICAL findings from upstream Debian 12 packages without available bookworm fixes. Management image 0.1.17 replaced this package set with Wolfi. These vulnerabilities exist in third-party OS packages (nginx, clamav/python, ncurses, systemd, zlib, sqlite, nghttp2, openldap, libexpat) and are not in containd's own code.

notes.text: The v0.1.16 container image switched from a distroless base to debian:bookworm-slim and installs nginx, clamav, nftables, unbound, openvpn, openntpd, and tcpdump via apt. This introduces known CVEs from upstream Debian packages including: libexpat1 (CVE-2026-25210), openldap (CVE-2023-2953), ncurses (CVE-2025-69720), nghttp2 (CVE-2026-27135), cpython/libpython3.11 (CVE-2025-13836, CVE-2025-15366, CVE-2025-15367, CVE-2025-69534, CVE-2025-8194, CVE-2026-1299, CVE-2026-4519), sqlite (CVE-2025-7458), systemd (CVE-2026-29111), nginx (CVE-2026-27651, CVE-2026-27654, CVE-2026-32647), and zlib (CVE-2023-45853). None of these have fixed versions in Debian 12 bookworm at the time of publication.
notes.title: Description

notes.text: These historical findings concern third-party OS packages in the management 0.1.16 image, not containd source code. Upgrade to management 0.1.17 or later, and restrict access to trusted management networks. The package-set replacement resolves this advisory; it is not a claim that Wolfi or any later release has no vulnerabilities. Consult each release VEX and current scans for that release.
notes.title: Mitigations
Version and image scope
notes.text: The management runtime changed to debian:bookworm-slim in 0.1.16 and to Wolfi in 0.1.17. The engine image existed in both releases but retained its distroless Debian 12 runtime with staged nftables until its separate Wolfi migration in 0.1.18. This advisory covers the management 0.1.16 package set only; it makes no affected or fixed assertion about the engine or earlier distroless images. The tagged Dockerfiles establish runtime base and staged nftables provenance, not the exact vulnerable package versions shipped by the engine; no affected engine package set is established here.

remediations.details: Upgrade to v0.1.17 or later. The Debian-slim base image was replaced with Wolfi, eliminating the inherited Debian 12 CVEs.
